title: COBIAS: Assessing the Contextual Reliability of Bias Benchmarks for Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing the contextual reliability of bias benchmark statements by inserting generated contexts via LLM text infilling and measuring the variance in pseudo-log likelihood (PLL) scores using masked language models.
